body:
Addressed: the conflict with `main`. The PR has no review yet, so there are no review findings. The new head is `17b2d962e22918cf24d676f0ddbbdbf75b9f6176`.

## What changed

- The branch took `git merge upstream/main` (main at `39298012074799bf84677c63dc3d34200af8326c`). It is a merge commit. There is no rebase and no force-push.
- One file had a conflict: `crates/post/tests/script_goldens/script_heidenhain_klartext.rs`.
  - Main added the module `klartext/cycle_tests.rs` to the flat file (#4227).
  - This PR moved that file into the `script_goldens` suite and changed the `#[path]` lines to `../klartext/...`.
  - The two sides are kept. The new module is declared as `#[path = "../klartext/cycle_tests.rs"] mod cycle_tests;`.
- `git show --remerge-diff 17b2d962e` shows only that hunk (2 lines added, 6 conflict lines removed). The class is DELTA.
- Git applied the other edits of main to the moved files without a conflict (`script_heidenhain.rs`, and the `xtask` files).

## Evidence, on the final head

- Pin: the 6 tests of `cycle_tests.rs` are in the suite. `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_goldens -- --list` lists 6 names with `cycle_tests::`. The source file has 6 `#[test]`.
- Mutation: I changed the path back to `klartext/cycle_tests.rs`. `cargo check --tests -p camcraft-post` was red (`couldn't find file crates/post/tests/script_goldens/klartext/cycle_tests.rs`). I restored the line. The check was green, and the tree was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 31 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
  - post: build, lib and the 9 suites.
  - sim: build and the 8 suites.
  - app: `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `tilt_basis_compat`.
  - `xtask` unit tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: 0 steps.
- Goldens moved: none. The merge brought `recorded/golden/heidenhain-klartext/picomax_cycles.nc` from main without a change.

## Not exercised

- The light lane was not run again for this merge.
- Windows and Linux were not built.

The PR stays a draft. Please review the new head.

Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4421, Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), mkinney / .claude-team2 seat; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4421#issuecomment-7227184902

## Scope

- The PR moves test sources only. It changes no post script, no machine file, no generator, no sim or gouge code and no golden. Thus this is not a safety-tier review.
- No `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock` or dependency change. The `xtask/` change is in two test files only. I built it locally.
- No `crates/ui` change. Screenshots are not necessary.
- No file under `testdata/` and no importer code changed. The extra STEP and importer suites do not apply.

## What looks good

- No flat `.rs` file stays in `crates/post/tests/` or `crates/sim/tests/`. I checked each file in each suite directory against the `mod` lines of its `main.rs`. Each test file has a declaration. The five files without a line are helpers that a `#[path]` reads (`coincident_arcs/reader.rs`, `klartext/*_tests.rs`, `macro_b/expr.rs`).
- The `#[test]` count in `crates/post` and `crates/sim` is 1834 on `upstream/main` and 1834 on the head. The `#[ignore]` count is 5 on the two sides.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim --tests -- --list` on the head lists 2363 tests (5 ignored). The body says 2353; the difference comes from the tests that the merge of `main` added (for example `script_sinker_side`).
- The merge commit `17b2d962e` has one hand-resolved conflict in `script_heidenhain_klartext.rs`. The resolution keeps the three `klartext` modules (`arc_tests`, `cycle_tests` from #4395, `dialect_tests`), each with `../`. This is correct.
- The new pin in `every_shipped_post_script_has_its_suite` also checks the `mod` line in `script_goldens/main.rs`.
- No post or sim suite is in `ISOLATED` (`xtask/src/lanes.rs`) or `SLOW_BINARIES` (`xtask/src/plan.rs`).
- `Process change: yes` is in the body. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` does not change. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #3188`. The decision file `docs/decisions/3188-fold-post-sim-suites.md` is present.

## Results (locally, on m3, macOS; PR head = trial merge, it already contains `upstream/main` 392980120)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 31 steps, 0 failed. This includes post lib and the 9 post suites, the 8 sim suites, `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, 6 other app part suites, and the xtask unit tests.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: one error at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67`. The PR does not touch that file. The same code is on `upstream/main`. This is not a blocker.
- Heavy lanes: not run. The body shows that the heavy plan has 0 steps for this diff. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" does not require them.

Extra suites run: none were owed (no `testdata/` and no importer change). The `example_catalog` suites ran in the quick gate above.

## Mutations

1. I removed `mod script_fanuc;` from `script_goldens/main.rs`. The pin `recorded_streams::every_shipped_post_script_has_its_suite` was red ("script_goldens/main.rs does not run script_fanuc"). I restored the line. The pin was green.
2. I changed the xtask pin `cps_only_change_selects_the_suites_posting_through_it` back to the old name `fanuc_post`. The pin was red ("fanuc_post missing from [...]"). I restored it. The pin was green. Thus the xtask pins read the real suite names.
3. I removed the counter from `recorded::tmp`. `script_goldens` stayed green on two runs. This agrees with the body: a collision is not deterministic, and no test can make it fail each time. The counter is a correct defensive change.

## Goldens moved

None. I agree: no `.nc`, `.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed.

## Optional, non-blocking

- Only `script_goldens` has a guard for a missing `mod` line. In the other 16 suites, a new file without a `mod` line does not compile and its tests do not run, with no error. Before this PR, Cargo found each flat file automatically. A small xtask or suite check ("each `.rs` in a suite directory is declared") can close this class for all directory suites, the app suites included. Suggested follow-up: `P7`.
- `reach_laws::radial_rapids::forty_pecked_radial_holes_verify_clean_within_a_wall_time_bound` asserts less than 3 s in debug. It now shares one process with the other `reach_laws` modules. It passed here. If it becomes unstable on a slow runner, look at this first.
- The stale path comments outside this diff are in #4420.
